verdicts.sentence:
**Path resolution:** The script is called with `${HOME}` expanded by the shell at runtime, so it works
whether the printer host is a Raspberry Pi, an Orange Pi, a Debian VM, or a BTT CB1 —
no hardcoded `/home/pi/` anywhere.
verdicts.corrected: **Path resolution:** The script is called with `${HOME}` expanded by the POSIX shell at runtime (per IEEE Std 1003.1-2017 §2.6.1 Parameter Expansion), ensuring compatibility across any POSIX-compliant host — Raspberry Pi, Orange Pi, Debian VM, or BTT CB1 — with no hardcoded `/home/pi/` path.
